messages:
ops_jules: Vendor update: FRA customs short-hold on one pallet. They propose two options: 1) consolidate at EU cross-dock and rebook D2D (adds 4 days, no surcharge) or 2) direct-to-depot air for 4 priority H100s at +$1.4k/unit. Need quick ops call — affects eu-west-1 priority pool.

vendor_eric: Correct. Cross-dock consolidation reduces immediate cost but delays ETA. Direct-to-depot air gets 4 priority units in 48h. We can include QR-coded RMA labels stuck to crate and a serial->tempID mapping CSV if you want temporary IDs on AWB. Insurance: vendor proposes 25/75 (vendor/redwood) on air, 50/50 on sea.

infra_maya: Cluster note: eu-west-1 has two NVLink-degraded hosts and one rack showing thermal margin alerts. If we get 4 early, route to NVLink nodes first. Depot has a single high-power bench, so coordinate power test slot.

finance_rob: Budget: +5.6k surcharge for air option. We can approve under emergency spend but require vendor to preprint RMA QR labels and include a shock log. Prefer 20/80 insurance but will accept 25/75 if vendor prepays duties for air (+$350).

depot_adam: Cross-dock can take up to 16 crates on weekday morning. Direct-to-depot air needs advance notice for power test — book 48h window. We prefer full serials on AWB; temp IDs increase reconciliation work. QR labels are fine and speed processing.

ops_jules: Quick poll: prefer to air 4 direct-to-depot to restore NVLink racks, consolidate rest at cross-dock. If vendor will prepay duties and include serial CSV + QR RMA labels and shock log, finance ok with 25/75.

vendor_eric: We can prepay duties (+$350) and include serial CSV and QR labels in crates. Will mark air AWB: EU-3255-01 and manifest link: https://shipments.vendorco.com/manifest/EU3255. Return SLA: 7 days for air DOA, 14 days for sea.

infra_maya: Ops: schedule cordon/drain for NVLink hosts N-EW-12/N-EW-13 in 2hr window. Can we also run a single-node canary replacement to validate crate power?

ops_jules: Opening OPS ticket OPS-5120 and scheduling canary tonight 23:00-23:30 UTC. If AWB + PO amend live, approve air. finance_rob text me the PO amend number.

finance_rob: Starting PO amendment now. Will include duty prepay line and emergency code. Reply with "ack" when vendor posts AWB + serial CSV.

vendor_eric: ack 1 1 posting AWB + serial CSV into thread when generated.

logistics-bot: manifest uploaded: https://shipments.vendorco.com/manifest/EU3255 1 AWB EU-3255-01 created. Tracking note added.

ops_jules: Great. Closing after PO and manifest confirmed.
